thread.title: Buffett tells CNBC out of IBM, not going to acquire General Electric

author: fifcadmin
title: Buffett tells CNBC out of IBM, not going to acquire General Electric
text:
May 4, 2018 - 8:06am The Fly
Warren Buffett told CNBC's Becky Quick that Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A) is effectively out of its position in IBM (IBM) and that he has no plans to acquire all or parts of General Electric (GE), as has been speculated by the market. Berkshire holds its annual shareholders meeting in Omaha this weekend. Buffett also told Quick, as reported overnight by CNBC, that Berkshire acquired an additional 75M shares of Apple (AAPL) in the first quarter. Go! Market Summary
